$schema_note: Machine-readable index of this repo for coding agents. Fetch raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/houstongolden/bamfai-examples/main/examples.json

categories.examples: Small, single-purpose pieces (HTML pages, scripts) an agent can pull down and use directly in a session.
categories.starters: Full starter applications (Next.js, Vite, etc.) built on the BAMF API/MCP — scaffold a project from these.
categories.audiences: Every entry declares an 'audience': 'creator' (single-creator workflows — what's published here today) or 'agency' (multi-creator/agency workflows — planned in ROADMAP.md as coming soon, none published yet).

examples.title: Post Review HTML
examples.description: BAMF-branded local HTML page for reviewing generated post drafts with exact LinkedIn line-break rendering. Agents: generate drafts, render this, open it, keep editing in chat.
examples.when_to_use: Any time you create or edit BAMF post drafts in a terminal agent session and the user needs to review copy.
